name: a11-control
description: Canonical local and production entrypoint for A11

scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.doctor:prod: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$status = (Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing 'https://api.funesterie.pro/api/status' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content | ConvertFrom-Json); $status | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10; Write-Host ''; $remoteUrl = [string]$status.integrations.qflush.remoteUrl; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($remoteUrl)) { throw 'Missing qflush remoteUrl in backend status payload.' }; (Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing (($remoteUrl.TrimEnd('/')) + '/health')).Content"
